option.name: rain_toggle
option._long: Starts rain (random drops on the whole screen); it keeps raining until the binding is used again. Also available as the IPC method water/rain_toggle.

option.name: rain_drops
option._long: Average number of drops per second on each output.

option.name: rain_intensity
option._long: How hard the drops hit the surface, in percent: higher values make stronger, longer-lasting ripples. Each drop still varies randomly between 75 and 100 percent of this value.

option.name: rain_drop_size
option._long: Radius of a drop in pixels; bigger drops make bigger ripples.
